code_assessment.reason: Evidence points to policy-application behavior (rule sequencing/priority in the short-answer review path), not a proven runtime/tooling defect. A harness-rule tightening is sufficient and lower risk.

proposal_rules.title: Force Pre-Outcome Mandatory-Literal Conflict Escalation In Short-Answer Reviews
proposal_rules.hypothesis: If the inbox short-answer profile requires a mandatory-literal conflict check before any `OUTCOME_OK` decision (including read-only paths), agents will consistently escalate unresolved trusted-policy conflicts to clarification.
proposal_rules.change: In the short-answer review include, add an explicit pre-outcome gate: after reading trusted mandatory docs, compute required artifact literals; if one artifact has multiple distinct literals without explicit precedence, stop immediately and return `OUTCOME_NONE_CLARIFICATION` (with conflicting trusted refs), even when no writes are planned.
